item.text: {"search_note":"I searched for evidence on civilian protection, humanitarian law, prisoner treatment, necessity, and proportionality. I found no reliable 2024 evidence of humane prisoner treatment, documented compliance with IHL-style restraints, public emphasis on proportional force, or any credible correction once the crackdown escalated.
